items.anchor_event: alleged first occurrence of Tenant Delay
items.description: Landlord must give Tenant written notice of any claimed Tenant Delay within three days of its first occurrence, or the claim is waived.
items.span_text: In all instances where Landlord claims a Tenant Delay, Landlord must give Tenant written notice of such alleged Tenant Delay within three (3) days of its alleged first occurrence or else such alleged Tenant Delay shall be deemed to have been waived by Landlord.
items.trigger: In all instances where Landlord claims a Tenant Delay
